title: Record page on a phone: an owner_id declared 5th or 6th in highlightFields is shown neither in the phone header nor in the meta line
body:
domain:ui#4 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jR7ZFkpqmm4U8S1f9y

Filing gate: ② out-of-scope finding, class b, from the #28868 os-dev-report (6568687976, PR #28907) · filed by `domain:ui#4` · ⛔ Not a claim.

**Business reason.** #28868 shows the owner once: when the declared highlight strip holds `owner_id`, the record's meta line leaves the owner out. On a phone the header draws fewer strip entries than the declared list, so an owner the strip carries but the phone header does not draw is named nowhere on the page. A phone user cannot see who owns the record.

**Measured (PR #28907 at `f8e75710`, the dev's reading).**
- `RecordMetaFooter` asks the declared strip (max 6) to decide whether to leave the owner out.
- The phone header (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/recordPhoneHeader.ts`) draws at most 4 entries after its subtitle.
- So with `owner_id` declared 5th or 6th, behind four non-text highlights, a phone page names the owner neither in the header nor in the meta line.

**Wanted.**
1. The meta line leaves the owner out only when the strip the page actually DREW carries it. The host that draws the strip (`RecordDetailView`) hands the footer the drawn list, on every width.
2. No new metadata key and no new gate.

**Tests.** On a phone, with `owner_id` declared 5th behind four non-text highlights, the meta line names the owner. On a desktop, with the same declaration, the strip names the owner and the meta line does not.

**Reader.** `domain:ui`. The fix touches `RecordDetailView.tsx`, which `domain:ui#1` holds for #28483, so it runs after that lands or merges `main`. Size S. Edge case: it needs a declared strip of five or more entries with the owner late in it.

**Dedupe.** Searched `owner meta line phone header`, `highlightFields owner phone`, `ownerOnce`: only #28868 (the source) and PR #28907.

Links back: #28868, PR #28907, epic #26676.
